subtitle: "Southern Ocean regions for the Marine Ecosystem Assessment for the Southern Ocean"
toc: false
---



The MEASO regions divide the Southern Ocean into **five sectors** and **three zones**, giving 15 regions
for assessment, summary and comparison. A fourth, northern band in each sector (the "T" regions) covers
the remaining ocean to 30°S so that any location in the domain falls in exactly one region.

## Get the data

| Format | Polar (equal area) | Longitude/latitude | EPSG:3031 |
|---|---|---|---|
| GeoParquet | [measo_regions06.parquet](data/v06/measo_regions06.parquet) | [measo_regions06_ll.parquet](data/v06/measo_regions06_ll.parquet) | [measo_regions06_epsg_3031.parquet](data/v06/measo_regions06_epsg_3031.parquet) |
| FlatGeobuf | [measo_regions06.fgb](data/v06/measo_regions06.fgb) | [measo_regions06_ll.fgb](data/v06/measo_regions06_ll.fgb) | [measo_regions06_epsg_3031.fgb](data/v06/measo_regions06_epsg_3031.fgb) |
| GeoJSON | | [measo_regions06_ll.geojson](data/v06/measo_regions06_ll.geojson) | |
| QGIS style | [measo_regions06.qml](data/v06/measo_regions06.qml) | | |

Each file has one row per region with columns `name`, `label` (e.g. "Antarctic Atlantic"), `sector`,
`zone` and `fill` (the region's colour).
See [Data](data.qmd) for details and stable URLs, and the **Use** menu for reading the regions
in [R](r.qmd), [Python](python.qmd), [DuckDB](duckdb.qmd), [the browser](web.qmd) and [QGIS](qgis.qmd).

In R, the [measoshapes](https://github.com/AustralianAntarcticDivision/measoshapes) package provides
the regions as data sets:

```r
remotes::install_github("AustralianAntarcticDivision/measoshapes")
library(measoshapes)
measo_regions06
```

## How the regions are defined

The regions are built from lines: sector boundaries, three simplified ocean fronts, and the domain
edges (85°S to 30°S, all longitudes). Their boundaries are straight lines in longitude/latitude.
See [Definition](definition.qmd).
